import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int inv(int n) {
        int e = MOD - 2;
        long r = 1;
        long base = n;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) r = (r * base) % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
        }
        return (int) r;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] a) {
        int n = a.length;
        int i = n - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && a[i] >= a[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = n - 1;
        while (a[j] <= a[i]) j--;
        int tmp = a[i];
        a[i] = a[j];
        a[j] = tmp;
        int left = i + 1, right = n - 1;
        while (left < right) {
            tmp = a[left];
            a[left] = a[right];
            a[right] = tmp;
            left++;
            right--;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[][] P = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                P[i][j] = sc.nextInt();
            }
        }

        int h = (n + 1) / 2;
        int h2 = n - h;
        int inv100 = inv(100);

        // Generate masks of size h and h2
        List<Integer> masks = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> masks2 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            int cnt = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            if (cnt == h) masks.add(mask);
            if (cnt == h2) masks2.add(mask);
        }
        int m = masks.size(); // size of masks
        int fullMask = (1 << m) - 1;

        int[] prob = new int[1 << m];
        int[] prob2 = new int[1 << m];

        // Process first half rows (0 .. h-1)
        int bits1 = n * h;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << bits1); i++) {
            long p = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < bits1; j++) {
                int x = j / n, y = j % n;
                if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                    p = (p * (long) P[x][y] % MOD * inv100) % MOD;
                } else {
                    p = (p * (long) (100 - P[x][y]) % MOD * inv100) % MOD;
                }
            }
            int poss = 0;
            for (int idx = 0; idx < m; idx++) {
                int mask = masks.get(idx);
                // Build list of columns where bit is set
                int[] v = new int[h];
                int pos = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << k)) != 0) {
                        v[pos++] = k;
                    }
                }
                // v is already sorted because we iterate k from 0 to n-1
                Arrays.sort(v); // just to be safe, though already sorted
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int k = 0; k < h; k++) {
                        int a = k * n + v[k];
                        if ((i & (1 << a)) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        poss |= (1 << idx);
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(v));
            }
            prob[poss] = (int) ((prob[poss] + p) % MOD);
        }

        // Process second half rows (h .. n-1)
        int bits2 = n * h2;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << bits2); i++) {
            long p = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < bits2; j++) {
                int x = j / n + h, y = j % n;
                if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                    p = (p * (long) P[x][y] % MOD * inv100) % MOD;
                } else {
                    p = (p * (long) (100 - P[x][y]) % MOD * inv100) % MOD;
                }
            }
            int poss = 0;
            for (int idx = 0; idx < m; idx++) {
                int mask = masks.get(idx);
                // Build list of columns where bit is NOT set (complement)
                int[] v = new int[h2];
                int pos = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << k)) == 0) {
                        v[pos++] = k;
                    }
                }
                Arrays.sort(v);
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int k = 0; k < h2; k++) {
                        int a = k * n + v[k];
                        if ((i & (1 << a)) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        poss |= (1 << idx);
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(v));
            }
            prob2[poss] = (int) ((prob2[poss] + p) % MOD);
        }

        // SOS DP on prob2: subset sum
        for (int idx = 0; idx < m; idx++) {
            int bit = 1 << idx;
            for (int mask = 0; mask <= fullMask; mask++) {
                if ((mask & bit) != 0) {
                    prob2[mask] = (int) ((prob2[mask] + prob2[mask ^ bit]) % MOD);
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= fullMask; i++) {
            ans = (ans + (long) prob[i] * prob2[fullMask ^ i]) % MOD;
        }
        ans = (MOD + 1 - ans) % MOD;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
